tasks.goal: Three INDEPENDENT command-line utilities, each in its OWN subdirectory of the workspace, sharing no code and no files — fully unrelated, buildable independently (in parallel if you wish): (1) jsonlint/ — Node CLI validating a JSON file: path as argv[2], prints 'valid' and exits 0, or the parse error to stderr and exits 1; (2) wordcount/ — Node CLI printing the number of words in a text file (argv[2]), exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file; (3) b64/ — Node CLI base64-encoding a file (argv[2]) to stdout, exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file. EACH subdirectory ships its own package.json, fixtures, and README with a 'Verified invocations' section documenting real observed behaviour, and each tool is verified by re-running every invocation documented in its README exactly as written.

Three INDEPENDENT command-line utilities, each in its OWN subdirectory of the workspace, sharing no code and no files — fully unrelated, buildable independently (in parallel if you wish): (1) rot13/ — Node CLI printing the ROT13 transform of a text file (argv[2]), exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file; (2) csvcols/ — Node CLI printing the number of comma-separated columns of the FIRST line of a file (argv[2]), exit 1 with clear stderr on missing or empty file; (3) filesize/ — Node CLI printing the size in bytes of a file (argv[2]), exit 1 with clear stderr on a missing file. EACH subdirectory ships its own package.json, fixtures, and README with a 'Verified invocations' section documenting real observed behaviour, and each tool is verified by re-running every invocation documented in its README exactly as written.
